rules.control_character: Unicode Cc character other than tab, CR or LF.
rules.html_entity: Named or numeric entity that html.unescape changes.
rules.invisible_format_character: Unicode Cf character other than joiners U+200C/U+200D.
rules.no_letters_or_numbers: No Unicode letters or numbers; may be valid emoji sentiment.
rules.possible_mojibake: Common broken UTF-8 sequences; heuristic only.
rules.possible_promotion: At least 2 distinct promotion phrases; heuristic only.
rules.repeated_character_run: Same non-whitespace character repeated at least 6 times.
rules.short_text: Fewer than 3 whitespace-separated units OR fewer than 10 characters.
rules.url_or_mention_only: Only URLs/mentions, whitespace and surrounding punctuation.
